snowwear.config.title: Snow Wear
snowwear.config.enabled.tooltip: Snow settles on visible players during snowfall and melts under cover.
snowwear.config.accumulationSeconds.tool: Time to reach full snow coverage while standing in snowfall.
snowwear.config.meltSeconds.tooltip: Time for full coverage to melt without snowfall. Water and fire melt it four times faster.
snowwear.config.maxCoverage.tooltip: Limit how much snow can settle on clothing.
snowwear.config.showSelf.tooltip: Show snow on your model in third person and inventory views.
snowwear.config.showOthers.tooltip: Show snow on nearby visible players. Up to 64 players are tracked.
snowwear.config.renderDistance.tooltip: Track snow on other players within this distance.
snowwear.config.sponsor: Sponsored by CTF Launcher — try it out
snowwear.config.saveError: Could not save Snow Wear settings
snowwear.config.saveError.detail: Check write access to the config folder.
snowwear.config.armorSnow.tooltip: Raise snow caps above helmets and armored shoulders. Custom oversized armor may cover them.
snowwear.config.movementShedding.tooltip: Sprinting, jumping and landing shake off small snow flakes and reduce coverage. Up to 24 flakes spawn per tick.
